prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`, localized Undo actions on the Episodes page delete toast in both languages, and backend tests.

check.why: copy, dense order and restore all work together, guarded, page actions in both languages, tests and changelog

+@router.post("/{episode_id}/restore", response_model=EpisodeOut)
+def restore_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: str,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a deleted episode with its cuts back to the place it had.
+    """
+    try:
+        episode_uuid = UUID(episode_id)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_uuid)
+    if not episode:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(current_user_id)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID)
+
+    member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == project.workspace_id)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.user_id == user_uuid)
+    ).first()
+    if not member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    if episode.deleted_at is None:
+        return _build_episode_out(session, episode)
+
+    active = _active_project_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    target_order = min(max(1, episode.episode_order or 1), len(active) + 1)
+    insert_idx = target_order - 1
+
+    episode.deleted_at = None
+    active.insert(insert_idx, episode)
+    for idx, ep in enumerate(active, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != idx:
+            ep.episode_order = idx
+        session.add(ep)
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+
+    return _build_episode_out(session, episode)
+
+
+@router.post("/{episode_id}/duplicate", response_model=EpisodeOut)
+def duplicate_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: str,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Duplicate an episode and its cuts right after the original episode.
+    """
+    try:
+        episode_uuid = UUID(episode_id)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_uuid)
+    if not episode or episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(current_user_id)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID)
+
+    member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == project.workspace_id)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.user_id == user_uuid)
+    ).first()
+    if not member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    existing = _active_project_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    orig_idx = next((i for i, ep in enumerate(existing) if ep.id == episode.id), len(existing) - 1)
+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=episode.project_id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary or "",
+        episode_order=orig_idx + 2,
+        status="ready",
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits) if episode.character_outfits is not None else {},
+    )
+    session.add(new_episode)
+    existing.insert(orig_idx + 1, new_episode)
+    for idx, ep in enumerate(existing, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != idx:
+            ep.episode_order = idx
+        session.add(ep)
+    session.flush()
+
+    cuts = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order, StoryCut.created_at)
+    ).all()
+
+    for cut in cuts:
+        new_cut = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=cut.cut_order,
+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,
+            status="idle" if cut.status == "generating" else cut.status,
+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues) if cut.dialogues is not None else [],
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters) if cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],
+            embedding=copy.deepcopy(cut.embedding) if cut.embedding is not None else None,
+            refer_prev_cut=cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        )
+        session.add(new_cut)
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+
+    return _build_episode_out(session, new_episode)
+

+
+    def listed():
+        eps = client.get("/api/v1/episodes", params={"project_id": pid}, headers=h).json()
+        assert [e["episode_order"] for e in eps] == list(range(1, len(eps) + 1))
+        return [e["id"] for e in eps]
+
+    assert listed() == [e1["id"], e2["id"], e3["id"]]
+
+    # Duplicate Act I -> goes right after Act I (order 2), shifting Act II (3) and Act III (4)

+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{c2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert listed() == [e1["id"], c1["id"], e2["id"], e3["id"], c3["id"]]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{c1['id']}", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 2

+    # Delete first episode (e1 at 1) -> closes the gap, remaining start at 1

+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e3['id']}/restore", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 3
+    check_order([only["id"], e2["id"], e3["id"], e4["id"]])
+
+    # Delete e2 (place 2), duplicate `only` (new copy at 2), then restore e2 -> e2 takes place 2, pushing copy to 3
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    dup = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{only['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    check_order([only["id"], dup["id"], e3["id"], e4["id"]])
+
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e2['id']}/restore", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    check_order([only["id"], e2["id"], dup["id"], e3["id"], e4["id"]])
+
+    # Calling restore again on an already-active episode leaves order unchanged
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e2['id']}/restore", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    check_order([only["id"], e2["id"], dup["id"], e3["id"], e4["id"]])
+

+def test_only_workspace_members_may_restore_others_get_404(client):
+    owner_headers = signup(client, email="owner@example.com")
+    outsider_headers = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    teammate_headers = signup(client, email="teammate@example.com")
+
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=owner_headers, json={"title": "Private", "genres": []}).json()
+    ep1 = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=owner_headers, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": proj["id"]}).json()
+    ep2 = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=owner_headers, json={"title": "Ep 2", "project_id": proj["id"]}).json()
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 204
+
+    # Unauthenticated request is refused
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member gets 404 NOT_FOUND_EPISODE and episode remains deleted
+    r_outsider = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_headers)
+    assert r_outsider.status_code == 404
+    assert r_outsider.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 404
+
+    # Nonexistent IDs and invalid UUIDs return 404 NOT_FOUND_EPISODE
+    r_missing = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_missing.status_code == 404
+    assert r_missing.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    r_bad = client.post("/api/v1/episodes/not-a-uuid/restore", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_bad.status_code == 404
+    assert r_bad.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    # Workspace member (teammate) can restore
+    owner_ws_id = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner_headers).json()[0]["id"])
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        teammate = session.exec(select(User).where(User.email == "teammate@example.com")).one()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=owner_ws_id, user_id=teammate.id, role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+
+    r_teammate = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=teammate_headers)
+    assert r_teammate.status_code == 200, r_teammate.text
+    assert r_teammate.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    eps = client.get("/api/v1/episodes", params={"project_id": proj["id"]}, headers=owner_headers).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in eps] == [(ep1["id"], 1), (ep2["id"], 2)]
+
+    # If project itself is deleted, restoring returns 404
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 200
+    r_del_proj = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_del_proj.status_code == 404
+    assert r_del_proj.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+

+def test_restoring_episode_is_free(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Free Restore", "genres": []}).json()

+    ws_id = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"])
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        ws = session.get(Workspace, ws_id)
+        ws.credits = 0
+        session.add(ws)
+        session.commit()
+
+    FakeGemini.calls.clear()
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert FakeGemini.calls == []
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        ws = session.get(Workspace, ws_id)
+        txs = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == ws_id)).all()
+        assert ws.credits == 0
+        assert txs == []
